description: List the AIO public RFCs — the public comment periods in which a contested standards-pack or methodology decision is put out for comment before it is treated as settled. Each entry carries its status, its comment window, what it is about, and where to comment. Review windows follow the AIO Public RFC Process v1.0 (Draft ≥ 14 days, Candidate ≥ 30 days). CC BY 4.0.
